faq.q: What is the origin of Ramatoulaye?
faq.a: Ramatoulaye is associated with Arabic. Ramatoulaye is the West African (Fulani) form of Arabic رَحْمَةُ اللَّه (Raḥmat Allāh), meaning 'mercy of God'.
Yes — the underlying form رَحْمَةُ اللَّه is Arabic.

Ramatoulaye should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Raḥmat Allāh is a compound of Quranic elements, not itself a Quranic personal name.
